senses.sense_definition: To cause people or things to separate and move in different directions.

examples.text: The police arrived and the crowd began to <w>scatter</w> in all directions.

target_lang_translations.nl: De politie arriveerde en de menigte begon in alle richtingen <w>uiteen te gaan</w>.

target_lang_translations.nl: De wind zorgde ervoor dat de droge bladeren over het gazon <w>verspreid</w> raakten.

senses.sense_definition: To cause light or particles to move in different directions after hitting a surface.

examples.text: The atmosphere helps to <w>scatter</w> sunlight, which makes the sky appear blue.

target_lang_translations.de: Die Atmosphäre hilft dabei, das Sonnenlicht zu <w>streuen</w>, was den Himmel blau erscheinen lässt.
target_lang_translations.zh: 大气层有助于<w>散射</w>阳光，这使得天空呈现蓝色。
target_lang_translations.es: La atmósfera ayuda a <w>dispersar</w> la luz solar, lo que hace que el cielo parezca azul.

target_lang_translations.fr: L'atmosphère aide à <w>disperser</w> la lumière du soleil, ce qui rend le ciel bleu.
target_lang_translations.it: L'atmosfera aiuta a <w>diffondere</w> la luce solare, il che fa apparire il cielo blu.

target_lang_translations.it: Le superfici ruvide tendono a <w>diffondere</w> la luce più di quelle lisce e riflettenti.
